scholarships.title: Scholarships
scholarships.description: Define scholarships and request them for students. The school admin approves each award before it discounts the student's invoices.

form.description: A percentage or fixed amount off a student's fees. It can't be changed once created, only deactivated.

decide.reasonRequired: Enter a reason. Finance will see it.

approve.title: Approve this scholarship?
approve.description: {{student}} gets {{scholarship}} on invoices generated from now on. Invoices already issued don't change.

revoke.title: Revoke this scholarship?
revoke.description: {{student}}'s invoices generated from now on won't include {{scholarship}}. Invoices already issued keep their discount.
